import re

text = """At different times, about 7000 kinds of plants and hundreds of animals are used as food by human beings. The loss of species will reduce food diversity and make human beings rely on only a few major foods, thus breaking people's balanced diet. In addition, with the loss of species in the forest, the loss of species in the field may lead to an increase in the number of pathogens that are responsible for diseases in organisms. Some of the animals, plants and microbes that are most likely to become extinct are actually buffers for the spread of infectious diseases, which are responsible for many diseases on behalf of humans before they are infected."""
t = text.lower()

submitted = re.sub(r"[^A-D]", "", "A**")
print("Normalized submitted answer:", submitted)

# Each option is reduced to the key textual evidence needed to support it.
# (term, required) pairs: the option is supported only if all required terms appear.
options = {
    "A": [("endemic", "Option says 'endemic species'; text must mention endemic")],
    "B": [("loss of species", "species loss"), ("diseases", "disease/health link")],
    "C": [("food diversity", "food diversity reduced"), ("balanced diet", "diet disrupted")],
    "D": [("buffers for the spread of infectious diseases", "species-disease link"),
          ("increase in the number of pathogens", "species-disease link, two-sided")],
}

supported = {}
for k, reqs in options.items():
    ok = True
    for term, why in reqs:
        present = term in t
        print(f"  {k}: '{term}' present={present} ({why})")
        ok = ok and present
    supported[k] = ok

print("Supported by text:", supported)
unsupported = [k for k, v in supported.items() if not v]
print("Options not supported/inconsistent with text:", unsupported)

# The text says the species buffering disease are those "most likely to become
# extinct" (i.e. endangered), which is not the same as "endemic" species.
print("'endemic' in text:", "endemic" in t)
print("'most likely to become extinct' in text:", "most likely to become extinct" in t)

if unsupported == [submitted]:
    print("CHECK PASS (lexical/hand-encoded evidence check; reading comprehension is not formally provable)")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
